tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Search Printing Labs' live corporate-gifting catalog (custom apparel, drinkware, welcome kits, bundles). Filter by free-text keyword, exact category, maximum unit price in INR, or bundles only. Returns matches with canonical product page URLs.

tools.name: get-product-details
tools.description: Full public details for one product or bundle by its permalink slug (from search-products results) or numeric id: description, pricing, bulk-discount tiers, GST rate, minimum order quantity, stock signal, and page URL.

tools.name: list-product-categories
tools.description: All Printing Labs catalog categories with live product counts and their canonical category page URLs, plus the preset-bundle count.

tools.name: get-company-info
tools.description: Verified facts about Printing Labs: services, fulfillment regions, budget-tier collections, seasonal gifting hubs, machine-readable resources, and how to contact or request a corporate quote.

tools.name: calculate-bulk-price
tools.description: Compute the effective bulk price for a given product and quantity: applies the product's quantity-discount tiers and GST, validates the minimum order quantity, and shows the next discount tier. Indicative pricing — final quotes come from the sales team.

tools.name: list-catalogs
tools.description: The downloadable PDF catalogue library: every published catalogue with its title, description, page count, file size, and direct PDF URL.

tools.name: request-quote
tools.description: Submit a corporate quote request to the Printing Labs sales team on the user's behalf. Creates a real lead: the team receives it instantly (CRM + email + WhatsApp) and the requester gets a confirmation email. Only submit with the user's explicit consent and their real contact details.

tools.name: get-meeting-slots
tools.description: Available consultation slots (IST) with the Printing Labs team for a given date. Use before book-meeting; slots reflect the live calendar.

tools.name: book-meeting
tools.description: Book a consultation with the Printing Labs team: creates the Google Calendar event (with Meet link unless Phone Call), registers the meeting, and emails the requester confirm/reschedule/cancel links. The time must be one of get-meeting-slots' values for that date. Only book with the user's explicit

tools.name: track-order
tools.description: Live status timeline for an existing order. Requires the order id AND the email the order was placed with (both must match).

tools.description: HR/HRIS automation (requires an API key in the Authorization header — Bearer plk_…): turn new hires into welcome-kit claim links in one call. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create-onboarding-drop" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search-products, get-product-details, list-product-categories, list-catalogs, book-meeting · Private data: get-company-info, list-catalogs, request-quote, book-meeting, create-onboarding-drop · Public sink: request-quote, track-order, create-onboarding-drop · Destructive: create-onboarding-drop.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search-products, get-product-details, list-product-categories, list-catalogs, book-meeting · Private data: get-company-info, list-catalogs, request-quote, book-meeting, create-onboarding-drop · Public sink: request-quote, track-order, create-onboarding-drop · Destructive: create-onboarding-drop

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
